considerations: The site is a large industrial campus with flat-roof buildings, silos, tanks, overhead piping, lumber stacks, and outdoor storage. A golf course and water body sit on one side of the campus. Pelican Elementary School and residential streets sit near the opposite end of the block. Circulation space exists in the lots and yards, though equipment, stored materials, and neighboring buildings may limit movement in some corridors.
